Name: Second Wind
Author: CreativeCoder35
Description:
[size=5][b]Second Wind:
[/b][/size][size=3] ﻿When your energy reaches 0 (or 15 if `Early Second Wind` is enabled in the mod config), if your farming level is at least 1, then you regain an amount of energy based on your mining level. At farming level 4, the number of second winds you get per day increases to 2. It increases again at farming level 7, and again at farming level 10.[/size]

[size=5]Determination:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿Once per day, when your health drops to/below `Determination Threshold`, you regain [u]10 * your Combat level[/u] health.
[/size]


[size=1]This is my first ever Stardew Valley mod :)[/size]

Manifest.Name: Second Wind
Manifest.Description: When near exhaustion (or dying), recover energy (or health) automatically, based on your farming/mining/combat level!
Manifest.Author: CreativeCoder35
